verdicts.reason: A: the legal text opens the banner on the far left in four wrapped lines, almost as prominent as the message, and it crowds the tiny can and logo; the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon is shrunk to an illegible sliver jammed under 'longer', and the headline is small next to the CTA. B has the same backwards reading order (legal copy and a cramped can on the left) and the ribbon is still unreadably small, but its headline is larger and sets a clearer hierarchy, and the ribbon has a little more space below the headline. That makes B marginally the less broken of two poor results.
